answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in umber and sable lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the violet graph. A farm of 1517 identities would post 2069 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
